subject: Insurance
title: Workers' Comp Fraud
description: A micro-lesson that makes Workers' Comp Fraud usable.

hook.text: A man claimed a back injury kept him bedridden. Investigators filmed him parasailing on vacation.

buildup.text: Workers exaggerate or fake injuries to collect benefits. Some genuinely hurt workers extend claims far beyond recovery.

discovery.text: Surveillance is the top detection tool. Investigators follow claimants with cameras.

twist.text: Employers commit workers' comp fraud too—misclassifying employees to lower premiums.

climax.text: Workers' comp fraud happens on both sides: employees faking injuries and employers hiding risk.

punchline.text: Bedridden on paper, parasailing on video. Investigators always bring cameras.

quiz.question: How do investigators catch workers' comp fraud?
options: Surveillance footage and social media activity
